decisions.reference: Unmodified original A_BrainPain, A_BrainScream, A_BrainExplode and A_BrainDie compiled as host C. Spawn and state-entry boundaries use selected canonical data and the original random stream. Native probes call actual WorldSpawn/ActorState, recording resulting actors. All 592 result slots match.
scope: All 256 random starts for each ending action
All 65 scream explosions and every subsequent single explosion: x/y/z, vertical velocity, lastlook, state/frame/sprite and timer
Original 128/65536-unit height offset and eight-unit horizontal sweep
Random draw order and wrap, full-volume sound origin and timing, normal-exit replacement
Sound exceptions after a complete sweep and during pain
State callback exception after spawn/velocity publication, with no extra timer draw
Wrong owner, inactive source, invalid action and direct explosion helper checks
Unconditional brain death exit without a live player
Eighty actual ThinkersTick calls with continuing explosion chains, old-actor removal and bounded actor population
integration.controlledFailureSetup: One case temporarily attaches the valid pain action to the explosion entry state to exercise callback failure; the original state action is restored afterward.

remaining: Brain target collection and spawning cubes
Complete actor dispatcher and persistent native game host
